About Oscilar

Oscilar is building the Agentic Risk Platformâ¢ for banks and fintechs, reimagining how financial institutions manage fraud, credit risk, compliance and onboarding in the AI era.

Our platform brings decisioning, data and AI agents together in one system, so risk teams can make better decisions in real time and automate increasingly complex work. Agent Hub gives them 30+ specialized AI agents across fraud, AML, credit, onboarding, sanctions and disputes.

Oscilar is trusted by 100+ fintechs and financial institutions, including SoFi, MoneyGram and Nuvei, and makes tens of billions of risk decisions a year. ARR has grown 15x in the last 2 years.

Oscilar was founded by Neha Narkhede, co-creator of Apache Kafka and co-founder of Confluent, which went public at a valuation of about $10 billion and later agreed to be acquired by IBM for $11 billion.

The Role

We're hiring our first VP of Brand and Communications to lead Brand, PR and Communications and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk.

You'll own how Oscilar shows up in the market: the story we tell, the voice we tell it in, and where it gets heard. That means directing our PR to land Oscilar in Tier 1 publications and keep a steady drumbeat of coverage around every launch and milestone; defining a brand voice and guidelines that make us instantly recognizable as the agentic risk platform; launching brand campaigns that get financial services leaders talking; and turning our founder's industry profile into reach with the buyers we sell to.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy for brand, PR and comms, and personally get the first versions of the most important work out the door. You'll lead our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our PR agencies from day one, hire your first team member soon after joining, and build the team as results come in. You'll also build the playbook for an AI-native brand function, using agents and automation so a small team can do far more than its size suggests.

You'll report to Tomas Lobo, VP of Marketing and Growth, and work closely with our CEO and executive team, Product Marketing, Growth, Events and Design. This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on Oscilar's growth and reputation.

What You'll Own

Brand Strategy & Category Leadership

  • Own Oscilar's brand strategy end to end, and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk.

  • Work with our founders to sharpen the agentic risk narrative, and turn it into a point of view the market repeats back to us.

  • Turn executive alignment into a cohesive brand voice and brand guidelines, and make sure the brand shows up consistently across the website, sales, content, social and events.

  • Evolve the brand as the company grows: new products, new markets and new audiences.

  • Own the brand budget and investment plan, and decide where each dollar builds the most awareness and trust.

  • Make sure Oscilar shows up in AI search and LLM answers, not just traditional search and media.

PR & Communications

  • Set the bar for what great PR looks like, and direct our agencies (including Highwire) to get there.

  • Land Oscilar's story in Tier 1 publications such as Fortune and the Wall Street Journal.

  • Build a steady drumbeat of earned media around product launches, customer stories, company milestones and timely news.

  • Build lasting relationships with the media, analysts and industry voices that shape our market.

  • Run PR as the long game it is, while making sure Oscilar shows up in today's conversations.

  • Own crisis communications readiness and the corporate narrative around major company moments.

  • Partner with People on our employer brand, so the story we tell the market also attracts great talent.

Social Strategy

  • Own Oscilar's social strategy across founder-led, executive-led, employee-led and company channels.

  • Make each channel amplify the others, so a single story travels from Neha to our executives, our employees and the company page.

  • Build an employee advocacy program that turns our team into a distribution channel.

  • Measure social by reach and engagement with the buyers we sell to, not vanity metrics.

Founder & Executive Presence

  • Manage Neha's presence across social media, video, media, podcasts and events, building on her 50K followers and her standing in the industry.

  • Own her roadmap of speaking, media and social moments, so she shows up in the right places at the right time.

  • Build the platforms that make Neha and our executives and experts the voices people seek out on AI, fraud, credit and compliance.

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Set the long-term content strategy that builds Oscilar's authority in AI and risk: original research, data assets, signature franchises and executive points of view.

  • Bring Product Marketing, PR and content together around one shared plan, so every launch and campaign tells part of the same story.

  • Build content that compounds over time and becomes the reference point for our industry.

Brand Campaigns & Programs

  • Launch fast, high-ROI brand campaigns alongside long-term programs. Our first is the Agents of Risk awards program.

  • Run several bets in parallel, set clear goals for each, measure results, and decide quickly what to scale or stop.

  • Turn what works into flagship programs, partnerships and experiences that become recognized across financial services.

Team & AI-Native Operations

  • Lead and grow our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our agency partners from day one.

  • Build the Brand, PR and Communications team over time, adding your first hire soon after joining and growing the function as results come in.

  • Build an AI-native function: automate brand, PR and social workstreams with agents so a small team can do far more.

  • Define the function's priorities, operating rhythm and how we measure brand impact.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You've set the brand and PR strategy, are directing our agencies with a clear point of view, and have early wins on the board: earned media around our launches, a brand voice the company has adopted, and the first brand campaigns live and measured.

  • First year: Oscilar is recognized as the defining name in agentic risk. We have Tier 1 coverage and a steady drumbeat of earned media, a social presence that reaches the buyers we sell to across founder, executive, employee and company channels, and flagship programs the industry looks forward to.

  • Long term: You've built a high-performing, AI-native Brand, PR and Communications team, and brand has become one of Oscilar's biggest competitive advantages.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in brand, PR and communications, including leading brand and PR or comms at VP or Head-of level at a successful, sales-led B2B SaaS company.

  • Deep PR judgment. You've directed agencies to Tier 1 coverage and know what great looks like.

  • You've built a brand voice and guidelines that teams actually used, and you can take a messy draft and make it sharp.

  • You've run fast, measurable brand campaigns alongside long-term programs.

  • You're a hands-on player-coach: proactive, responsive, and quick to ship rather than theorize.

  • You're AI-native and have automated real marketing work with AI tools or agents.

  • You've managed experienced people and agencies, and aligned teams such as PMM and content on one plan.

  • You've owned a brand budget and managed creative teams and agencies across PR, design and video.

  • Clear, concise communication and strong creative instincts.

Bonus Experience

  • Selling to fintech, financial services, payments, identity, security or other risk and trust buyers.

  • Running a founder-led social program, especially for a technical founder.

  • Launching an awards program or other industry-recognition campaign.

  • Building a brand or comms function from scratch, or leading through a major moment such as an IPO or large announcement.

Why This Role Is Unique

  • Build from scratch, without the typical startup risk. You'll build Oscilar's brand function from the ground up at a company that already has product-market fit and has grown ARR 15x in 2 years.

  • A proven, second-time founder. Work directly with Neha Narkhede, who co-created Apache Kafka and co-founded Confluent, taking it to a roughly $10 billion IPO and an $11 billion acquisition agreement with IBM.

  • A manager who has done this before. Tomas Lobo helped build Samsara from $1M to close to $500M in ARR in about 5 years.

  • A category to name. Help define agentic risk, a new category at the intersection of AI, risk and financial infrastructure.

  • Room to build. A VP title, a seat with the founders, a PR partner already in place, and room to hire and build your team.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401k plan.

  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture.

  • Health: 100% employer-covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top-tier plan for you and your dependents. (US)

  • Balance: Unlimited PTO policy.

  • Culture: Family-friendly environment; regular team events and offsites.

  • Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities.

  • Impact: Help make the internet safer by protecting online transactions and building the infrastructure powering the future of financial risk.

You'll work directly with agency leaders, producers, and account teams to drive adoption, deepen relationships, and help shape how we scale customer success as the business grows. If you're energized by ownership, close customer partnership, and helping define the playbook as a company grows, you'll likely thrive here. Work closely with the Head of Customer Success and CRO on customer growth, retention, and expansion strategy. Own the customer experience end to end, from onboarding and activation through renewal and upsell. Help shape the product roadmap by being a direct voice of the customer. Join a high-caliber team built from Meta, IBM, Adobe, Salesforce, DocuSign, and Uber, with real ownership, strong trust, and meaningful equity. Nice to have Experience across multiple lines of business (P&C, Employee Benefits, specialty). Outmarket is an AI-powered platform purpose-built for commercial insurance agencies. We help brokers, MGAs, and carriers extract insights, automate workflows, and move faster by turning unstructured data into action.

Our customer base is growing quickly, and we're looking for a Customer Success Manager with commercial insurance experience to help us scale. This person will be a strategic partner to our customers and an important internal voice as we keep building our product and go-to-market approach.

About the Role

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to own the post-sale customer journey for a portfolio of agency, broker, and carrier accounts. You'll report to the Head of Customer Success and work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, partnering with customers from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

This is a high-impact role for someone who understands how commercial insurance agencies operate and enjoys building in a fast-moving environment. You'll work directly with agency leaders, producers, and account teams to drive adoption, deepen relationships, and help shape how we scale customer success as the business grows. If you're energized by ownership, close customer partnership, and helping define the playbook as a company grows, you'll likely thrive here.

Why This Role

  • Join a company with strong customer momentum and a lot of opportunity ahead.

  • Work closely with the Head of Customer Success and CRO on customer growth, retention, and expansion strategy.

  • Own the customer experience end to end, from onboarding and activation through renewal and upsell.

  • Help shape the product roadmap by being a direct voice of the customer.

  • Join a high-caliber team built from Meta, IBM, Adobe, Salesforce, DocuSign, and Uber, with real ownership, strong trust, and meaningful equity.

What You'll Do

  • Own onboarding and activation for agencies, brokers, and carriers using the Outmarket platform, so customers see value fast and adopt the product widely.

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with agency principals, department leaders, producers, and account managers.

  • Be the main post-sale contact for implementation, training, ongoing engagement, retention, and account health.

  • Find expansion opportunities in existing accounts, whether that's new teams, new lines of business, or new use cases.

  • Turn customer feedback into product insights that help set roadmap priorities.

  • Use AI tools like Claude every day to prep for customer conversations, analyze account health, build content, and scale yourself across a growing book of accounts.

  • Build and improve onboarding materials, training content, and Customer Success processes that can scale with the business.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Implementation, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.

  • AI fluency is a must. We're an AI company, and our best CSMs use AI tools like Claude every day to work smarter. You either already do this, or you're eager to learn everything you can and put it to work right away.

  • Hands-on experience in commercial insurance, whether at an agency, brokerage, MGA, carrier, or an insurtech selling to them. You know how agencies are structured, how account teams work day to day, and what drives renewals.

  • A track record of owning a book of accounts and moving the numbers that matter: adoption, retention, and expansion.

  • Comfort leading onboarding and training for users ranging from agency principals to day-to-day account managers.

  • Strong communication skills. You can run an executive business review in the morning and a hands-on training in the afternoon.

  • The ability to spot patterns across customers and turn them into clear, useful feedback for Product.

  • A builder's mindset. You like creating playbooks, templates, and processes where none exist yet.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace. You take ownership without waiting for direction.

Nice to have

  • Experience across multiple lines of business (P&C, Employee Benefits, specialty).

  • Familiarity with agency management systems (e.g. Applied Epic, Vertafore AMS360) or other tools agencies rely on.

  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.

jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer, Foundations
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer to join Raya Foundations, the platform team that owns the shared foundation every other Raya engineering team builds on. On the client side that means the architecture of our iOS codebase, its modularization and build system, shared libraries and design-system components, CI and release tooling, crash and performance infrastructure, and the AI-collaborative development tooling our iOS engineers use every day. This is a senior client engineering role with deep technical impact across a large, long-lived swift iOS codebase. The ideal candidate has built and operated high-scale consumer iOS applications end to end, has been the engineer other iOS engineers come to for architecture and tooling, and is excited about modernizing a mature Swift codebase while keeping it shipping every week. Rather than owning one feature surface, you will partner with the product client teams, server engineering, and design to raise the engineering bar across the whole app. We offer comprehensive medical and dental coverage, $50 a day food delivery budget, equity based employment, a great culture, learning opportunities, unlimited vacation, 12 weeks paid parental leave, and we pay all employees $1,000 a year to go somewhere in the world that they've never been because of our values of human connection, empathy, and curiosity. Responsibilities Own the architecture of Raya's iOS codebase: set the patterns and best practices for state management, SwiftUI adoption, navigation, networking, and concurrency, and solve the hard client-side lifecycle problems that span teams. Drive modernization of a large, long-lived Swift codebase: modularization, SwiftUI alongside UIKit, Swift concurrency, and deliberate management of tech debt. Write the tech specs, make the trade-offs explicit, and sequence the work so it ships incrementally. Build the shared foundation other iOS engineers build on: design-system components, shared libraries, networking and persistence layers, and the dev harness (build times, CI, test infrastructure, release tooling). Build and roll out the AI-collaborative development tooling iOS engineers use every day, and set the standards for how we use it on the client. Improve client production health infrastructure: crash and performance monitoring, alerting, release quality, and the security posture of the app. Partner with server engineering on API design and client-server state sync, and with the product client teams so new features land on solid patterns. Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code review, mentorship, and clear written specs. Requirements 5+ years of professional iOS development experience, with strong proficiency in Swift, UIKit, and MVVM. Strong experience with RxSwift or similar reactive programming frameworks, and with Redux-style state management patterns. A track record of shipping consumer mobile apps to large audiences, with strong judgment on architecture, performance, and user experience. Experience owning client platform or infrastructure work that other engineers depend on (modularizing a large iOS codebase, build and CI systems, shared libraries, design systems, or release tooling) and driving its adoption. Proven ability to lead projects from concept through launch, balance speed and quality, and own what you ship after it ships. You use AI coding tools in your daily work, help the team adopt them, and look for opportunities to improve the engineering harness. What Sets You Apart Deep experience with SwiftUI alongside UIKit and with Swift concurrency (async/await, actors, strict concurrency), including migrating a mature codebase to them. CoreData a plus! Experience with Xcode build performance, Swift Package Manager or Bazel/Tuist, and CI/CD for iOS at scale. Has built developer tooling, agents, or evals that other engineers adopted: code review agents, lint and architecture rules, test generation, or LLM-powered dev harnesses. Occasional comfort or interest in shipping production backend code (Node.js/TypeScript) alongside the client, and designing the APIs mobile clients depend on. Experience with mobile security: device trust, certificate pinning, secrets handling, or security remediation on the client. raw_payload.description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Headquarters: Remote US

Head of Content

Outmarket AI · Remote (US) · Full-time · Reports to the SVP of Marketing

About Outmarket

Insurance still runs on manual work. Most policies are sold through agents and brokers, and the people who know the work best are buried in the documents: checking policies line by line, comparing quotes, building proposals, on nights and weekends. We think that's backwards. The best people in insurance should spend their time advising clients.

Outmarket, the AI platform built for insurance, makes that possible. Account teams drop in their documents and get back finished work to review, with every finding linked to the page it came from. Outmarket connects to the systems they already use. The judgment stays with the person; the groundwork doesn't.

It's working. More than 10,000 people at over 300 agencies use Outmarket, including 30 of the top 100 U.S. insurance brokers. Most of those agencies found us through other customers. We raised a $34.5M Series B led by SignalFire four months after announcing our Series A because customers were pulling us forward faster than we planned.

Why this role

  • Customers who want to talk. About 300 agencies use Outmarket, and most will go on record about it. Few content leaders start with that many stories ready to tell.

  • First in the seat. You'll be our first content hire, joining alongside a new Head of Product Marketing and Head of Growth. You'll decide what Outmarket sounds and looks like.

  • Real creative room, and a budget to use it. There's budget for specialist contractors such as editors, shooters and designers, and you'll have room to make work that doesn't look like typical B2B content.

  • A direct line. You'll work with the SVP of Marketing, the founders and customers, and you'll see what your work does for pipeline within weeks.

The role

You own video, social, customer stories and written content. You'll build the function hands-on: you script, interview, direct and write yourself, and you work with a small group of specialist contractors instead of an in-house crew. Pipeline is the team's main number, so success means content that brings brokers into sales conversations, not just views.

Our buyers are owners, producers and operations leaders at commercial insurance agencies. It's a relationship-driven industry, and we're still learning where these buyers spend their attention online. Part of your job is finding out, then making the content that reaches them there.

What you'll do

  • Run the customer story program. Choose which customers to feature with our client services team, plan each story before the shoot, run the interview, and cut one day of filming into pieces for the website, ads, sales and events. Make it easy for busy customers to say yes, and never over-ask the same ones.

  • Ship every week. Build a steady publishing rhythm with a bench of specialist contractors. Find them, brief them clearly, know what things should cost, and review closely so quality holds as volume grows.

  • Turn our events into content. Work with our Director of Industry Events & Programs to plan what to capture at the conferences and customer dinners we already run, and publish soon after.

  • Find where brokers pay attention, whether that's LinkedIn, YouTube, industry media or events. Put our effort where the audience is, not where content teams usually start.

  • Build leaders' voices. Help our founders and other leaders post every week, each in their own voice.

  • Own written content, including the site, social and long-form pieces, and keep everything we publish clear and sharp.

  • Measure what your content does for pipeline and use that to decide what to make next.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in B2B content, brand or creative, including time owning a content program end to end.

  • You've personally made content that grew an audience or produced demos and pipeline, and you can explain the numbers and your part in them.

  • You're a hands-on maker. You've scripted, directed, interviewed and edited video and social content yourself, not only managed an agency or writers.

  • You've produced customer stories people actually watch, and you know how to run a great interview.

  • You've shipped on a small budget with contractors and can say what each piece cost.

  • You've built content at an early-stage company, ideally Series A to C, and want to build from scratch again.

  • You're an excellent writer.

How we work

  • High agency: you find the work instead of waiting for it.

  • Ownership: you own the outcome, not a task list.

  • Startup pace: we ship weekly instead of planning quarterly.

You don't need to know insurance. Curiosity about brokers is the requirement, and becoming fluent is part of the job.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/outmarket-ai-head-of-content

You own how Outmarket is described to brokers, to the sales team, to the market, and to the analysts and press who will shape the category. You'll pick up positioning work that's already in motion, test it with brokers and sales, and own how the story changes as the product and the market move. You're the first product marketer, so you do the work yourself before you build a team. We expect to add one or two product marketers in 2027.

  • Turn verified results into value messaging and business cases buyers can take to their partners.

  • Write the content buyers use to evaluate AI for their brokerage

  • Run product launches with the product team: naming, packaging, launch messaging, enablement and customer communication.

  • Partner with sales leadership on enablement, both at kickoff and on a regular cadence, and measure whether the story lands in real deals.

  • Talk with customers, prospects and lost deals all the time, and be the voice of the broker inside the company.

  • Inform pricing and packaging with buyer research and competitive data.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing. You've owned positioning for a product end to end and can show the before and after.

  • You're an excellent writer. Your headlines are short, your decks are clear, and sales reps actually use what you make.

  • You're comfortable with executives who have strong opinions, and you change their minds with customer evidence.

  • High agency: you find the work instead of waiting for it.

  • Ownership: you own the outcome, not a task list.

Headquarters: Remote, US

Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Google Cloud & Gemini Enterprise Administrator to join our IT organization and manage Keeper’s Google Cloud, Google Workspace and Gemini Enterprise environments. This role offers 100% remote work.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help securely scale the cloud and AI platforms used across Keeper’s global workforce.

 

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

The Google Cloud & Gemini Enterprise Administrator will report to the Director of IT and serve as a key technical resource for Keeper’s Google Cloud and enterprise AI environments. You will administer Google Cloud projects, identity and access controls, Gemini Enterprise licensing and configuration, enterprise data integrations and related Google Workspace services. You will work closely with IT, Information Security, Compliance and business stakeholders to ensure Google and Gemini services are secure, scalable and configured according to enterprise governance requirements. This role requires strong hands-on Google administration experience along with an understanding of identity, security, SaaS administration and emerging enterprise AI technologies.

 

Responsibilities

  • Administer Google Cloud projects, IAM roles, service access and related enterprise cloud configurations
  • Manage Google Workspace administrative settings, users, groups, permissions and security controls
  • Administer Gemini Enterprise licensing, user access, administrator roles and platform configuration
  • Configure and maintain identity and authentication integrations supporting Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise
  • Implement least-privilege access controls and role-based permissions across Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise environments
  • Configure and manage Gemini Enterprise data connectors and enterprise data sources
  • Support integrations between Gemini Enterprise and platforms such as Google Drive, Jira, Slack, Salesforce, Microsoft SharePoint and other enterprise systems
  • Administer security and data-access controls governing how Gemini Enterprise interacts with organizational information
  • Configure AI security and governance controls, including appropriate protections for prompts, sensitive data and enterprise content
  • Monitor platform usage, access activity, logs and administrative events to identify issues or security concerns
  • Partner with Data Privacy, Information Security and Compliance teams to ensure Google and Gemini environments align with Keeper security and governance requirements
  • Troubleshoot complex access, licensing, identity, connectivity and configuration issues across Google Cloud, Workspace and Gemini Enterprise
  • Manage user lifecycle, licensing and access provisioning for Google and Gemini services
  • Maintain documentation for configurations, access policies, administrative procedures and support processes
  • Evaluate new Google Cloud, Workspace and Gemini Enterprise capabilities and recommend improvements to security, usability and operational efficiency
  • Support deployment and governance of custom Gemini agents and enterprise AI workflows
  • Assist business teams with adoption of approved Gemini Enterprise capabilities and enterprise AI best practices
  • Use scripting, APIs and automation where appropriate to streamline administrative and provisioning workflows
  • Use AI-enabled tools effectively to improve technical research, troubleshooting, documentation and workflow efficiency

 

Requirements 

  • 5+ years of experience administering enterprise cloud, SaaS, identity or IT systems
  • Strong hands-on experience administering Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace environments
  • Experience with Google Cloud IAM, roles, permissions, projects and organizational access controls
  • Experience managing Google Workspace users, groups, security settings and administrative controls
  • Strong understanding of identity and access management, authentication, authorization and least-privilege principles
  • Experience administering or supporting enterprise AI platforms, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini for Google Workspace or similar AI-enabled enterprise technologies
  • Experience managing SaaS licensing, user provisioning and enterprise application access
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data security, data access and governance principles
  • Experience troubleshooting complex cloud, identity and SaaS configuration issues
  • Familiarity with APIs, scripting or automation using Python, PowerShell, Google Apps Script or similar technologies
  • Strong documentation and communication skills with the ability to work across IT, Security, Compliance and business teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to evaluate emerging AI capabilities and balance usability with enterprise security and governance requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Ability to work on-site up to 5 days per week when required for projects or operational needs

 

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

 

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Headquarters: US - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:

We're looking for a highly accountable, commercially minded Renewals Manager to lead a team responsible for managing renewals, reducing churn, and protecting revenue across AMS and APJ. Working alongside a counterpart Manager of Renewals in EMEA, this person will bring operational discipline, forecast accuracy, and a customer-first mindset — while coaching their team to think strategically, manage flexible time zone coverage, and ensure effective time support in APJ.

You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. This role requires someone who can drive results across a portfolio of accounts, partner cross-functionally to remove roadblocks, and elevate the renewal experience for both our customers and internal stakeholders.

Your Impact:

  • Forecast & Execution Discipline
  • Own renewal forecasting across assigned segments — including pipeline health, coverage, and weekly projections
  • Lead structured forecast cadences (1:1s, team reviews, Save Rooms) to ensure every renewal has a plan, owner, and timeline
  • Partner with Sales, Legal, and Finance to proactively resolve deal blockers and streamline the path to close
  • Team Leadership & Operational Rigor
  • Manage and coach a team of Renewal Managers on renewal strategy, account planning, and customer negotiations
  • Instill high operational rigor across the team to consistently drive price increases (PI) and ensure on-time renewals
  • Foster strong cross-functional partnerships with key teams to align on strategic account goals and remove deal blockers
  • Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Identify patterns in churn risk, competitive pressure, or internal friction — and build motion-level solutions (e.g., playbooks, escalation paths, enablement)
  • Collaborate with AM, Marketing, and Product teams to align on customer health and commercial outcomes
  • Lead and refine internal processes to improve renewal efficiency and customer experience

Your Qualifications:

  • 3–6 years of experience in Renewals or Sales leadership within a SaaS environment
  • Proven ability to lead a team to hit revenue goals while balancing customer outcomes
  • Track record of accurate forecasting, structured deal reviews, and cross-functional execution
  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate complex deals, renewals, and procurement processes
  • Excellent coaching and team development skills
  • Comfortable in high-urgency, high-accountability environments

Standout Qualities:

  • Experience with top-down renewal risk (e.g., vendor consolidation, budget cuts)
  • Familiarity with enterprise SaaS customers, multi-product motions, and time zone coverage requirements for APJ support
  • Knowledge of Salesforce, Wrike, Tableau, or similar tools

Team Dynamics:

You will lead the AMS and APJ renewals team, collaborating closely with your counterpart Manager of Renewals in EMEA. You will be responsible for ensuring seamless time zone coverage and effective support across APJ and AMS regions. You will have direct reports, adept at navigating complex renewal negotiations. Together with your team, you'll work closely with departments across Wrike, including Sales and Account Management, to align on goals, share insights, and collaborate on innovative retention strategies.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • Company 401(k) Match
  • Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Health Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
  • Disability (STD, LTD) & Life Insurance Plans
  • Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly)
  • $500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend

Your recruitment buddy will be Aziza Talhi, Senior Recruiter.

#LI-AT1

The range below reflects the total on-target earnings (including base salary and performance-based bonus potential) for this full-time position and applies to all U.S. locations, excluding benefits and other incentives. The final offer within this range will consider factors such as the role, seniority level, geographic location, and employment contract type. An individual’s work location, unique skills, experience, and relevant educational background will also influence the final offer. For tailored compensation details based on your preferred location, please discuss with your recruiter during the hiring process.

Total compensation pay range
$110,000—$140,000 USD

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
 
Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
 
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona 

  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. 

Our culture and Values 

Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. 

Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

 
Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-manager-of-renewals-ams-apj

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: Headquarters: Americas Remote Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io . We're looking for a staff engineer to set technical direction for the systems that move billions of messages a day. This isn't a role about shipping more, faster. It's about deciding what gets built, where the architecture needs to go next, and raising the ceiling for the engineers around you. About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, Ember and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence. What We Value Ownership at company scale You take on the problems nobody has claimed yet — the ones that span squads, have no obvious owner, and would quietly cost us a year if left alone. You either solve them or get leadership aligned to. Engineers with product taste You think like a user, not just an engineer. You connect architectural decisions to what customers actually experience, and you can explain that connection to people who don't write Go. A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done" You retire practices that have outlived their usefulness, including ones you helped build. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion. Force multiplication Your best quarter isn't measured by what you shipped. It's measured by what the department can now do that it couldn't before. What You'll Do Shape the technical direction of our distributed messaging systems in Go — making the high-level architectural calls on mission-critical services where scale, cost, and reliability are all in tension Take on ambiguous, high-stakes problems that cross squad and function boundaries, and drive them to a decision when the right answer isn't obvious to anyone yet Build consensus on contested technical questions across teams, and communicate the tradeoffs clearly enough that senior leadership can act on them Raise the department's bar — set quality and design standards, mentor senior engineers, and turn what you know into frameworks and documentation other teams can use without you in the room Drive engineering process and tooling improvements that span multiple squads, not just your own Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the reliability of the systems you build Interview and calibrate against our career ladder, giving honest, evidence-based assessments of candidates Use AI agents to make multi-file changes by scoping the work, writing the prompt, and verifying the output What we're looking for 10+ years building scalable, distributed systems in Go (or similar statically typed languages), including several as the person others turned to on architecture Depth across multiple systems or domains, not just one — you've been the recognized expert in more than one place A track record of designing for production reality: you quantify tradeoffs in throughput, cost, and reliability rather than picking a reasonable path and defending it Experience designing observability and recovery as first-class concerns — metrics, alerting, rollback, backpressure, checkpointing — not logging added afterward Comfort working in cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP), with relational databases (we use MySQL) and a real understanding of performance tradeoffs Evidence of making other engineers better: mentorship, technical writing, design review, standards that outlasted your involvement A bias for action over perfection, and the judgment to know which decisions are worth slowing down for Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $200,000 - $240,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role also carries a 10% annual bonus target. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build. We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. See full benefits here → Our Process No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. Application - We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested. Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for and how we work. Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a project you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise. Architecture Interview (60 mins) - A collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges, tradeoffs, and failure modes. Take-Home Assignment - Complete a short, realistic task similar to what you'd work on here. Assignment Review Call (60 mins) - Walk us through your work and discuss tradeoffs, priorities, and how you'd iterate. All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process. Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact. Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io . Join us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone—apply now. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-staff-software-engineer-backend

The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions. Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out. You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Experience managing a tax reporting vendor or reporting platform, including scoping, testing, and holding the vendor to a delivery calendar. the tax platform vendor experience is a plus. Experience building a function from a small base: writing the policy, designing the controls, hiring the team, and running the first cycle. Ability to explain data and tax issues plainly to executives, engineers, and local compliance officers, and to run a steering committee. Judgment on when to escalate, comfort working across US, EU, and Asia time zones, and a record of meeting hard filing deadlines. Nice to Haves Experience with US Form 1099-DA or 1099-B production, backup withholding, or Qualified Intermediary reporting. Experience with the DAC8 60-day account restriction process or equivalent undocumented account remediation at scale. Familiarity with GDPR requirements for sharing customer data with tax authorities, including data protection impact assessments. Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks. Experience working inside a Three Lines Model, including supporting second-line monitoring and Internal Audit. A CPA, chartered tax adviser, or equivalent; or a degree in data science, computer science, or accounting. Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events More that we love to tell you along the process! jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote Roles - EMEA Who We Are At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. About the Opportunity OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions. Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out. You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads. Location: remote available, with a strong preference for the US or EU. Some travel to OKX offices. What You'll Be Doing Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries. Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline. Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release. Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision. Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers. Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product. Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team. Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee. Hands-on leader. Build a small, senior team, scaled through the reporting vendor and outside advisers. Coordinate with and train local compliance and entity leads. Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support tax authority examinations with complete, reproducible records. What We Look For In You 7+ years in tax information reporting, tax operations, or regulatory data reporting at a global exchange, broker, bank, fintech, or digital asset platform, including at least 3 years leading a team. Hands-on experience in a global, distributed digital asset business: you have worked with exchange or wallet transaction data, multiple legal entities, and users spread across many jurisdictions. This is required. Strong data skills. You can write SQL, define data specifications for engineers, reconcile large transaction datasets to a ledger, and find the gap when the numbers do not tie. You have built or run data quality controls on reporting output. Working knowledge of CARF, DAC8, CRS, and FATCA, including due diligence rules, self-certification requirements, reportable transaction categories, and the XML schemas used for exchange. Direct CARF or DAC8 implementation experience is strongly preferred given live DAC8 obligations and upcoming CARF reporting. Experience managing a tax reporting vendor or reporting platform, including scoping, testing, and holding the vendor to a delivery calendar. the tax platform vendor experience is a plus. Experience building a function from a small base: writing the policy, designing the controls, hiring the team, and running the first cycle. Ability to explain data and tax issues plainly to executives, engineers, and local compliance officers, and to run a steering committee. Judgment on when to escalate, comfort working across US, EU, and Asia time zones, and a record of meeting hard filing deadlines. Nice to Haves Experience with US Form 1099-DA or 1099-B production, backup withholding, or Qualified Intermediary reporting. Experience with the DAC8 60-day account restriction process or equivalent undocumented account remediation at scale. Familiarity with GDPR requirements for sharing customer data with tax authorities, including data protection impact assessments. Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks. Experience working inside a Three Lines Model, including supporting second-line monitoring and Internal Audit. A CPA, chartered tax adviser, or equivalent; or a degree in data science, computer science, or accounting. Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants More that we love to tell you along the process! Curious, resilient, and energized by helping build new ways of delivering care. jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Sourcing
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote - US Join the Tilt team At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide , we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward. The Opportunity: Manager, Strategic Sourcing Tilt is hiring its first Strategic Sourcing lead, with the opportunity to establish strategic sourcing as a function and practice at the company. The core of the role is commercial judgment and hands-on negotiation: you'll quickly understand what each team needs, assess vendor economics, and secure the best pricing and terms across the US and our international markets in Latin America and Asia. You'll focus your time on negotiations and measurable savings, keeping requirements gathering and vendor selection proportionate to the decision. Our spend spans banking and payments, credit and identity data, cloud and software, marketing, servicing and collections, and contractors and professional services. In this senior, hands-on role, you'll partner closely with Compliance, Legal, and Finance, help prepare Tilt for an initial public offering (IPO), and typically run five or more sourcing projects at a time. How You’ll Make an Impact Lead supplier negotiations : Own negotiations from new contracts to renewals and usage-based pricing, using should-cost models, market benchmarks, and competing bids to win better pricing and terms. Apply practical commercial judgment: Work with business owners to identify essential needs quickly, challenge unnecessary scope, and evaluate pricing, usage commitments, and total cost. Use targeted market checks or competitive bids where useful, and formal RFPs only when the complexity or value of the purchase warrants them. Apply zero-based vendor budgeting: Partner with Finance and business owners to justify vendor spend from current needs, expected usage, and business value rather than carrying forward last year's budget. Challenge renewals and minimum commitments, and identify services to eliminate, consolidate, or right-size. Set global category strategy : Manage spend by category across the US and our international markets, consolidate suppliers and negotiate global agreements where it lowers cost or risk, and set simple rules for small, one-off purchases. Build a simple sourcing and vendor management process: Partner with Legal, Compliance, IT, and Finance to design an easy-to-use workflow from vendor intake and onboarding through ongoing reviews, renewals, and offboarding. Establish clear owners, approval thresholds, risk-based reviews, and turnaround expectations so teams can navigate legal, compliance, and IT requirements without unnecessary handoffs. Build a practical negotiation playbook and coach teams on how to buy well. Make negotiated savings real: Partner with Finance and Accounts Payable on contract-to-invoice reviews, checking billed rates, usage, discounts, credits, and price increases against agreed terms. Resolve discrepancies with vendors, recover overcharges, and track realized savings against an agreed baseline. About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About Bybit and this role

Bybit is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, with a distributed workforce operating across many countries and time zones around the clock. Our people work in a fast-moving, highly regulated industry where speed, trust, and clarity matter every day.
This is a new role. As Bybit scales, how people experience the company has to be designed on purpose, not left to chance. The Head of Employee Experience & Innovation will build that experience end to end: the offices we work in, how employees hear from leadership, how we come together, and how engaged and connected people feel.

Mission

Make Bybit a place where talented people across every location feel informed, connected, and able to do their best work, and use data and new ideas, including AI, to keep improving that experience as we grow.

Key responsibilities

Employee engagement

  • Design and run the employee listening strategy: engagement surveys, pulse checks, lifecycle surveys, and exit insights.
  • Turn results into action plans with leaders, and track progress so employees see their feedback lead to change.
  • Shape the employee journey from onboarding to exit, removing friction at key moments.
  • Lead recognition programs and culture initiatives that reinforce Bybit's values.
  • Build community and belonging programs, including employee networks and wellbeing initiatives.

Internal events

  • Own the internal events calendar: all-hands, town halls, leadership offsites, team celebrations, and company milestones.
  • Deliver events across locations and formats (in person, hybrid, virtual) with clear goals, budgets, and measures of success.
  • Ensure events are inclusive and respectful of the cultural and religious diversity of our workforce.
  • Manage vendors, budgets, and logistics with strong cost discipline.

Internal communications

  • Build the internal communications strategy and editorial calendar.
  • Own and manage all internal communications channels: the intranet, company newsletter, all-company email, Slack or Lark channels, office digital screens, and leadership updates.
  • Own intranet content management end to end: content strategy, site structure, governance, publishing workflows, and keeping information accurate and current.
  • Set content standards and train content owners across functions so every team publishes clearly and consistently.
  • Partner with the CEO, executives, and the CPO on leadership messaging, change communications, and announcements.
  • Coordinate with Corporate Communications, Legal, and Compliance so sensitive or regulated messages are accurate and consistent.
  • Measure reach and understanding, and keep improving how information flows across the company.

Innovation

  • Bring new tools and ideas to the employee experience, including AI-enabled self-service, chat assistants, and automation of routine People processes.
  • Run small pilots, measure results, and scale what works.
  • Work with HR Technology and IT to keep the People tech stack simple, connected, and easy to use.

Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team across the four areas above.
  • Own the function's budget and vendor relationships.
  • Serve as a member of the People Leadership Team and a trusted partner to senior business leaders.

Workplace operations

  • Lead the global Workplace Operations team that manages Bybit's offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Malaysia, and other offices across APAC and EMEA.
  • Own office strategy and space planning, including openings, moves, expansions, and fit-outs, in partnership with Finance.
  • Set consistent workplace standards across all sites: facilities, health and safety, front desk, amenities, and spaces that support diverse needs such as prayer and wellness rooms.
  • Manage facilities vendors, service contracts, and office budgets with strong cost discipline.
  • Partner with IT, Security, and Legal on physical security, access, business continuity, and emergency response.
  • Use occupancy data and employee feedback to design offices people want to work in.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

Area
Outcome
Workplace operations
Consistent workplace standards across all four office locations; office space plan and budget agreed with Finance
Engagement
Company-wide listening program launched, with action plans owned by every executive
Internal events
Annual events calendar and budget set; flagship all-hands and leadership offsite delivered
Internal communications
Intranet organized with clear content owners and governance; channel strategy and editorial rhythm in place
Innovation
At least two People experience pilots (e.g., AI self-service) tested and measured
Team
Function fully staffed with clear roles and goals

What you bring

Requirements

  • 12+ years in People, employee experience, workplace, or internal communications, with 5+ years leading teams.
  • Proven ownership of at least two of: multi-country workplace or office operations, employee engagement, internal communications, or large-scale internal events.
  • Experience managing an intranet or other internal communications platforms, including content governance.
  • Experience in a high-growth, global company with employees in multiple countries.
  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable turning survey, occupancy, and channel data into decisions.
  • Excellent writing and editorial judgment, including drafting for senior executives.
  • Track record of managing budgets and vendors.
  • Fluent English.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience working in the Gulf region and across Asia and Europe.
  • Hands-on use of AI and automation to improve employee services.
  • Familiarity with HRIS, engagement, and communications platforms (e.g., Workday, Culture Amp, Lark, Slack).
  • Arabic or Mandarin is a plus.

How you lead

  • Builder. You create programs from a blank page and scale them as the company grows.
  • Data-driven. You measure what matters and use it to decide where to invest.
  • Executive presence. You earn the trust of the CEO and senior leaders and can push back with care.
  • Global mindset. You design for many cultures, languages, and time zones, not one headquarters.
  • Bias for action. You move fast, test ideas, and learn from what doesn't work.
  • Integrity. You handle sensitive information and messages with discretion and judgment.
Why Join Us
 
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:
  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-employee-experience-director

These channels are among the fastest-growing revenue streams at the company. They run on consumption-based, partner-reported data that changes every month.

You will be the accounting point of contact for the finance and partner teams at AWS, Google and Microsoft. Internally, you will partner with Finance, FAB, Engineering and business teams to turn partner billing feeds into accurate, auditable revenue. You will also lead the automation of a close that is still heavily manual. If you want to build the financial infrastructure behind a fast-growing AI company, come join us in our mission to build safe, beneficial AI.

  • Lead the revenue close for cloud service provider Marketplace within a listed company timeline.

  • Prepare and review revenue, revenue-share, reserve journal entries, accruals and true-ups including memos for accounting assessments and judgments.

  • Own balance sheet reconciliations, reserves, and the usage-to-invoice-to-cash bridge.

  • Perform monthly and quarterly flux analysis and prepare flux decks for leadership.

  • Own quarter-end deliverables, including footnote disclosures, flux commentary and presentations to leadership and Corporate Accounting.

  • Serve as the primary contact for external auditors.

  • Review the work of accountants and contractors, set the close calendar, and keep close packages complete and audit-ready.

  • Own monthly and quarterly 3P revenue reporting for leadership and FP&A, by partner, model, product, region and customer.

  • Serve as the accounting point of contact for the finance, engineering and product teams and drive reporting improvements that support an on-time close.

  • Apply ASC 606 to 3P arrangements, including principal-vs-agent, variable consideration and reseller arrangements.

  • Estimate and document reserves, including credit loss (ASC 326).

  • Assess the accounting for new 3P products, programs and billing changes, partnering with Technical Accounting on complex judgments.

  • Partner with the Engineering teams to automate manual close processes, including SQL-driven workbooks, automated reconciliations and system-generated journal entries.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About the Role

Anthropic runs one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry, across multiple accelerator families, CPU families, clouds, neoclouds, and on-prem sites. Capacity Engineering owns the data, tooling, and systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization of that fleet: we partner on supply deals, wire telemetry from day zero, own the canonical capacity data layer, and build the planning and enforcement tools every research and product team relies on. This role sits in the Planning pillar, on the Demand Planning team, and works daily with research engineering, pretraining, inference, compute supply, finance, and external vendors.

You own the tranches. The job has two halves that feed each other. Upstream, you take the Demand Planning forecast and turn it into per-tranche requirements — shape, interconnect, region, supporting resources, date — and carry those into sourcing negotiations and data center build reviews so we contract for capacity we can actually use when we need it. Downstream, you own the integrated schedule and system of record for every tranche in flight — from contracted through reserved, ingested, in-cluster, healthy, and occupied — and you drive the owners of each hop to their dates. Every slip you see downstream becomes a contract-language fix, an automation, or a correction fed back to the forecast.

What you'll do

  • Turn the forecast into per-tranche requirements. Take the Demand Planning forecast plus direct input from research, pretraining, and inference planners, and convert it into concrete accelerator, interconnect, region, supporting-resource, and date requirements for each tranche. Represent those in sourcing negotiations and data center build reviews, including which contractual terms actually move delivery dates.
  • Qualify tranches for deliverability before signature. The Capacity Planner signs fit-to-forecast; you sign whether the shape can land schedulable, healthy, and instrumented in that region on that date, with storage, egress, identity in place.
  • Close the delivery loop. Track forecast-versus-delivered on shape, region, and timing for every tranche; publish the variance; and feed it back to Demand Planning and into the next contract.
  • Own the bring-up system of record. Define the canonical contract-to-occupied state machine with explicit entry and exit criteria per stage, and make it a first-class object in the capacity data layer so every downstream tool sees in-flight capacity, not only what has landed.
  • Run a portfolio of bring-ups in parallel — new cloud regions, on-prem sites, neocloud blocks — with one integrated schedule spanning provider milestones, cluster creation, network turn-up, storage readiness, health burn-in, and first-workload landing. 
  • Drive readiness automation: All capacity systems are fully integrated for all new capacity, from contracted through ingested, automated and scaled.
  • Instrument and publish the numbers that matter — time-to-occupied and paid-idle dollars per tranche — with executive-level reporting on status, tradeoffs, and risk across the portfolio.

What you bring

  • Significant experience delivering large-scale infrastructure — cloud regions, accelerator clusters, HPC systems, or bare-metal fleets — at multi-region scale or ≥10k accelerators (or CPU/storage equivalent).
  • Technical range from through cluster orchestration and node health, up to the telemetry and planning tables on top — enough to debug where they disagree rather than route it.
  • SQL and enough Python to answer your own questions and build your own reporting.
  • A degree in a technical field or an equivalent engineering track record.

Preferred

  • Reserved-capacity onboarding, private offers, or capacity commitments with cloud or neocloud providers.
  • Enough demand-planning exposure to challenge a forecast, translate it into per-tranche requirements, and feed delivery variance back into it.
  • Data center or colocation delivery: power and space planning, network turn-up, site acceptance, vendor management.
  • Accelerator health and burn-in, collective-communications sanity testing, or fleet-health SLOs — and a rigorous definition of "healthy."
  • Systems of record or lifecycle services for infrastructure assets.
  • Onboarding a new hardware generation into an existing scheduler and observability stack.
